summary: Banco Bradesco S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing that its Board of Directors approved the payment of interim interest on shareholders' equity totaling R$3.5 billion (R$0.31536 per common share and R$0.34689 per preferred share). The record date is July 3, 2026, with ex-rights on July 6, 2026. Payment will occur by January 29, 2027, net of 17.5% withholding tax for most shareholders. This distribution is approximately 18.3x the prior monthly interest payment and will count toward mandatory dividends. The filing is a routine capital return, not a special situation beyond a regular distribution.
